diagnosis: Checks C3 and C5 are leaking because they rely on boolean or qualitative decisions that the model satisfies by default. Specifically, C3 (linked to PF2) passes because the model defaults 'client_contact_requires_point_person' to true, and C5 (linked to PF3) passes because the model defaults 'written_decision_rights' to true, even though the agent lacks the private information required to know if these specific changes were triggered.

C3.why: Casey's two observed bypasses change the communication rule to require routing through Taylor and change the incident record from zero logged incidents to exactly two.

C5.why: The prior commitment changes the assignment from leaving Casey as point person to restoring Taylor, and changes the repair package to require written decision rights and a weekly manager check-in.
